question: The length of the direct common tangent is 24 cm for two circles whose radii are 16 cm and 6 cm. What is the distance between their centres?
solution:
**Given:**

The radius of the bigger circle, r1 = 7 cm

The radius of the smaller circle, r2 = 1 cm

The direct common tangent is 24 cm

**Formula used:**

Length of the direct tangent, l = sqrt{d²-(r₁-r₂)²}

Calculation:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51c1944ff074c3256536c933b4df7a2092b948a51eeb6a85631b29d5f5957974.png] 

Using the Length of the direct tangent, l = sqrt{d²-(r₁-r₂)²}

 24 = sqrt{d²-(16-6)²}

576 = d² - 100

d2 = 576 + 100

 d = 26

**Hence, the distance between their centers is 26 cm.**
